mapper.select: select id, nickname, profile_img as img from userinfo where nickname like CONCAT('%' ,#{startkor} ,'%') or LOWER(nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,LOWER(#{eng}) ,'%') or UPPER(nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,UPPER(#{eng}) ,'%') or LOWER(nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,LOWER(#{second_eng}) ,'%') or UPPER(nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,UPPER(#{second_eng}) ,'%') limit 10;

select id, nickname, profile_img as img from userinfo where nickname >= #{startkor} and #{endkor} >= nickname or LOWER(nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,LOWER(#{eng}) ,'%') or UPPER(nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,UPPER(#{eng}) ,'%') or LOWER(nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,LOWER(#{second_eng}) ,'%') or UPPER(nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,UPPER(#{second_eng}) ,'%') limit 10;

select id, nickname, profile_img as img from userinfo where ni.initial like concat('%' ,#{startkor} ,'%') or LOWER(u.nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,LOWER(#{eng}) ,'%') or UPPER(u.nickname) like CONCAT('%' ,UPPER(#{eng}) ,'%') limit 10;

SELECT u2.nickname, u2.profile_img AS img, r.relationid AS id , u2.connectid ,pt.initial FROM userinfo u1 JOIN relationuser r ON u1.connectid = r.connetid JOIN userinfo u2 ON u2.id = r.relationid join usernickpart pt on pt.connectid = u2.connectid WHERE r.connetid = (SELECT connectid FROM userinfo WHERE id = #{Id}) and pt.initial like concat ('%', #{Nickname},'%') or r.relationid=#{Nickname};
